name: Shielding Effectiveness Evaluation
description: Ability to measure and evaluate the electromagnetic shielding effectiveness of enclosures, rooms, and facilities. Covers SE measurement methodology per IEEE 299/299.1 and related enclosure specifications (e.g., EN 50147-1, NSA 94-106), identification of shielding degradation, penetration and filter assessment, door and window seal testing, and evaluation of TEMPEST installation shielding adequacy.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to shielding effectiveness measurement

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands shielding principles and measurement standards
evidence: Can describe how electromagnetic shielding works (reflection, absorption, re-reflection)
Understands the basics of IEEE 299 shielding effectiveness measurement methodology
Completed training on shielding effectiveness evaluation fundamentals

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Performs shielding effectiveness measurements using standard setups under supervision
evidence: Set up transmit and receive equipment for SE measurement per lab procedures under guidance
Measured shielding effectiveness at specified frequencies following standard methodology under supervision
Identified measurement points (doors, penetrations, seams) under guidance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently conducts shielding effectiveness evaluations per applicable standards
evidence: Independently measured shielding effectiveness for 3+ enclosures or facilities
Identified shielding degradation points and documented their location and severity
Assessed penetration filters and waveguide-below-cutoff entries for shielding integrity
Produced SE evaluation reports with calibrated measurements referenced to applicable standards

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Evaluates complex shielded installations; diagnoses shielding failures; advises on remediation
evidence: Diagnosed shielding effectiveness degradation root causes in operational facilities
Evaluated shielding performance across wide frequency ranges including magnetic, electric, and plane-wave regimes
Advised facility operators on shielding remediation and maintenance
Mentors junior staff on SE measurement technique and standard application

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab SE measurement methodology; designs shielded facilities; recognized measurement authority
evidence: Authored the lab's shielding effectiveness measurement methodology
Designed or specified shielded room/facility construction to meet TEMPEST zone requirements (SDIP-28)
Maintained measurement traceability and calibration standards for SE testing
Trains teams on SE measurement and advises on shielded facility design and certification

assessment_methods.description: Measure the shielding effectiveness of a lab enclosure at specified frequencies, identify degradation points, and produce a standards-compliant evaluation report
Observe SE measurement setup, calibration, measurement execution, and degradation point identification

equipment: Keysight N9040B or equivalent spectrum analyzer
Calibrated signal generator with external amplifier
Calibrated broadband antenna set (biconical, log-periodic, horn)
Near-field probe set for leak detection
